channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran: Currently no negotiations with the US
item.description: Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson, Esmaeil Baghaei, said on Monday that Iran is not seeking negotiations with US.

item.title: Why a new war in Yemen could be different for the Houthis
item.description: Recent developments strengthen anti-Houthi forces in Yemen as signs indicate that a re-eruption of the war is imminent.

item.title: Five decades of Israeli covert strategy to push US, Iran into confrontation
item.description: Successive Israeli governments have undermined diplomatic efforts and stoked tensions between Washington and Tehran.

item.title: Three killed in suspected shootout in US city of Seattle, police say
item.description: Police say one suspect surrendered at the scene of the shooting, while the other remains on the loose.

item.title: Moment Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Belgorod
item.description: Dramatic videos captured the moment Ukrainian drones hit Belgorod, a Russian city near the Ukrainian border.

item.title: Ukraine dismisses Iranian threats as Caspian Sea strike directly links wars
item.description: Iran has reacted with fury to the assault on the vessel, with Tehran's foreign minister saying it "cannot go unanswered".

item.title: More than 600 US military service members injured since Iran War began in February
item.description: The latest figure includes casualties from Operation Fury and a new category called "Overseas Operations".

item.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
item.description: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give "talks some space", raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict.
